sections.section_title: Bathroom Renovation in Brampton & the Greater Toronto Area
sections.section_content:
Pinnacle Design | Build delivers complete bathroom renovation services for homeowners across Brampton and the GTA. We handle full bathroom remodels, walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, accessible bathrooms, custom vanities, tile installation, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and custom bathroom construction.

A bathroom renovation is not only about choosing beautiful tiles and fixtures. The most important work is often behind the walls — waterproofing, proper slope, plumbing, ventilation, tile preparation, and clean installation. We focus on bathrooms that look stunning, function properly, and last for years.

Whether you are updating a small bath, renovating an ensuite, creating a luxury master bathroom, or converting a tub into a modern walk-in shower, our integrated design-build team plans and completes your project with clear communication from start to finish.

sections.section_title: Built for Quality & Peace of Mind
sections.section_content:
Poor bathroom work can lead to leaks, moisture, mold, and costly repairs. We focus on preparation, craftsmanship, and honesty.

Licensed design-build team: Interior design, architecture, and construction coordinated under one roof.
Transparent estimates: Clear quote breakdown and payment schedule before work begins.
Proper waterproofing: Behind-the-wall details that protect your home long after install day.
Progress updates: Stay informed throughout demolition, rough-in, tile, and finishing.
Respectful job sites: Dust control, floor protection, and a clean, professional workspace.
GTA service area: Serving Brampton, Mississauga, Toronto, Vaughan, Markham, and nearby communities.

Full Bathroom Renovation: From demolition to finishing — walls, waterproofing, tile, vanity, fixtures, toilet, lighting, trim, shower glass, and final details. Ideal when your bath is outdated, damaged, or no longer fits your lifestyle.
Walk-In Shower Renovation: Layout, tile design, waterproofing, drain slope, niches, benches, fixtures, and glass. A shower that looks open, drains properly, and is easy to maintain.
Tub to Shower Conversion: Replace your bathtub with a shower tailored to your space, budget, and daily needs — popular for ensuites, rentals, and homes where the tub goes unused.
Accessible Bathrooms: Low-threshold showers, wider openings, grab bars, shower seats, non-slip flooring, easy-reach controls, and layouts designed for safer movement.
Fixture & Upgrade Work: Vanity, faucet, toilet, shower fixtures, mirrors, lighting, fan replacement, hardware, and minor drywall or paint repairs when a full gut isn't required.
Custom Bathroom Design: Custom vanities, heated floors, large-format tile, feature walls, luxury fixtures, LED mirrors, designer lighting, glass enclosures, and smarter storage.

sections.section_title: Hidden Work That Protects Your Home
sections.section_content:
Many bathroom problems start when prep behind the tile was skipped. We pay attention to waterproofing, slope, ventilation, and coordination that keeps your renovation performing for years.

- Shower waterproofing — helps prevent water damage
- Correct drain slope — water drains as it should
- Wall preparation — tile stays straight and secure
- Moisture-resistant materials — reduces humidity issues
- Plumbing & electrical coordination — fixtures, fans, heated floors
- Proper ventilation — healthier air and surfaces
- Dust control & protection — your home stays cared for

Q: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in the GTA?
A: Costs depend on size, layout changes, plumbing, electrical, tile, waterproofing, and fixtures. As a guide: basic updates often run $9,000–$18,000; standard full renovations $17,000–$29,000; premium or luxury baths $24,000–$41,500+. We provide a detailed estimate after reviewing your space.

Q: How long does a bathroom renovation take?
A: Basic projects may take 1–2 weeks. A standard full renovation is usually 2–3 weeks. Premium or complex bathrooms may take 3–4 weeks or longer depending on materials and site conditions.

Q: What is included in a full bathroom renovation?
A: Typically demolition, wall prep, waterproofing, tile, plumbing fixtures, vanity, toilet, shower or tub, lighting, fan, painting, trim, mirror, and final finishing — scoped to your package and estimate.

Q: Do I need a permit?
A: Permits may be required for structural changes, major plumbing relocation, electrical work, or layout changes affecting building systems. Cosmetic updates may not. We review scope and guide you accordingly.

Q: Do you build accessible bathrooms?
A: Yes. We can include low-threshold showers, grab bars, shower seats, wider openings, non-slip flooring, and layouts designed for safer movement.

Q: Do you help with material selection?
A: Yes. We help you choose tile, vanities, faucets, mirrors, lighting, and accessories — and can coordinate with trusted suppliers for your budget and style.

Q: Should I have a design idea before starting?
A: Having goals and reference ideas helps establish timeline and budget. Our design-build team can also develop layouts and selections with you if you are starting from scratch.
